title: Regulation record
description: One Chinese data/privacy legal instrument. Every record must trace to an archived primary source.

level.description: law=法律, regulation=行政法规, rule=部门规章/规定, standard=国家标准, guide=实践指南

document_number.description: e.g. 国家互联网信息办公室令 第18号

status.description: draft_for_comment = 征求意见稿, must never be presented as binding

topics.description: e.g. cross_border, personal_information, ai, minors, audit

source_id.description: archived source id from sources/MANIFEST.json. May be a comma-separated list when a fact spans several archived pages (e.g. a paginated law); in that case sources/text/<id>.txt exists for each element, not for the joined string. validate.py splits on commas.

verification.description: confirmed requires evidence_quote; disputed requires conflict_note

evidence_quote.description: verbatim quote from the archived text supporting the dates/status

conflict_note.description: required when verification=disputed: who says what, and why they differ
